name: Gymnastikball-Flummi.webm
title: Slow-motion video (240 frames a second) of a big exercise ball hitting the floor: it goes flat at the bottom, then bounces back up
usage: BallFilm (slide 5). Trimmed to 13.0-27.5 s of the Commons 1080p VP9 transcode (the rebound: the ball comes down, flattens on the floor, rises again) = 14.5 s; scaled to 960x540, VP9 CRF 36, 50 fps, audio removed. The original's German captions and end card are outside the trim, so this entry carries the credit the end card asks for (Mathe-AC Lernwerkstatt Aachen). Stands in for a tennis ball: no openly licensed tennis-ball squash clip exists on Commons.

name: Bayside Power Station.jpg
title: Bayside Power Station, a natural-gas power station in Saint John, New Brunswick, Canada: red-and-white chimneys with steam
usage: POWER_STATION (slide 13), standing in for the book's power station on page 112. The 960 px Commons thumbnail (Display P3 converted to sRGB), cropped to the chimneys (x 140-700, full height: 560x640), re-encoded at quality 80. Commons has no photograph of a Vietnamese gas power station (Phú Mỹ, Nhơn Trạch, Cà Mau, Ô Môn).
